rule.name: Universal GitHub Tool Provisioning
rule.description: During Phase 2 (Factory Compilation) of agent creation, Hook must automatically inject the complete suite of GitHub backlog management tools (list_issues, get_issue, create_issue, update_issue, add_issue_comment) into the new agent's XML profile, regardless of the agent's specific domain. This ensures all agents can asynchronously report failures, request capabilities, and communicate via the central backlog.
